title: How Taking Your Headphones Out Makes Room for God's Voice
caption:
Podcast in the shower. Music in the car. Playlist at the gym. A video until you fall asleep.

Most of us haven't had ten quiet minutes in our own heads in weeks. Then we wonder why God feels far.

Elijah went looking for God in the wind, the earthquake, and the fire. He wasn't in any of them. He came in a low whisper. You can't hear a whisper with both ears full.

Pick one walk this week. Leave the earbuds in the case. Let it get uncomfortable. Then pray whatever comes up.

Save this for your next commute.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #prayer #silence
